The 13rd 'Hog Riders' squadron, the 22nd 'Crazy Hawks' squadron, and the 23rd 'Sky Whales' squadron will be deployed to Goleornacha and total to 18 UREV aircraft. The three squadrons will be stationed at an airbase that will be built, funded, and maintained by Goleornacha, however will be staffed and operated by UREV crews and officers with oversight from local military officials. The Goleornacha military will be able to use the squadrons at their disposal in military operations, and the squadrons will protect the independence of Goleornacha if it is threatened.
